title: multi-agent-workbench tasks.json
description: Task queue for maw. Either an array of tasks or an object with "tasks" and run settings.

plan.description: Shown at the top of the dashboard.

source.description: Plan file the tasks came from.

max_parallel.description: Most tasks running at once (default: no limit).

budget_usd.description: Stop starting new tasks once reported agent cost reaches this.

agents.description: Custom agent CLIs. Keys are agent names usable as owner/command.

allow.description: Only pass these variables (plus PATH, HOME, USER, SHELL, TERM, LANG, TMPDIR and similar) to agents and checks. Omit to pass everything.

set.description: Extra variables for agents and checks.

sandbox.description: Command prefix that wraps every agent and check, e.g. ["docker","run","--rm","-v","{worktree}:{worktree}","-w","{worktree}","my-image"]. Placeholders: {worktree}, {id}, {owner}, {root}.

webhook.description: POSTed a JSON summary (with a Slack-compatible "text" field) when the run ends.

bin.description: Executable. Override at run time with MAW_BIN_<NAME>.

args.description: Must contain {prompt}. Nested arrays are optional groups, dropped when a placeholder in them is empty.

plan_args.description: Read-only invocation used by maw plan.

auth.description: Arguments for a non-interactive login check (exit 0 = logged in).

login.description: Command shown by maw doctor when not logged in.

prompt.description: Exact instruction sent to the agent.

owner.description: Queue name. Tasks with the same owner run one after another.

command.description: Agent CLI: claude, codex (chatgpt, openai), agy (antigravity) or a custom agent. Defaults to owner.

task.description: Short title for status and dashboard.

worktree.description: Worktree path relative to the repository root. Default ../<repo>-<owner>.

isolate.description: Run in its own worktree and branch, in parallel with the owner's queue.

check.description: Shell command that must exit 0 for the task to count as done.

retries.description: Extra attempts; failures are sent back to the agent.

max_cost_usd.description: Per-task spend limit (enforced by Claude Code; other agents: no further retries once reached).
